sourceText:
import css
import dns

func main(...) as int
    // 先验证正常输入，再单独观察谓词的非法输入合同。
    assert css.validate("a { color: red; }")
    assert dns.isIpv4("127.0.0.1") == 1
    println("valid inputs passed")

    int caught = 0
    try
        bool valid = css.validate("a { color: red;")
        println(valid)
    catch IOError e
        println("css predicate raised: " + e.message)
        caught += 1
    end
    try
        int valid = dns.isIpv4("256.1.1.1")
        println(valid)
    catch ValueError e
        println("dns predicate raised: " + e.message)
        caught += 1
    end
    assert caught == 2

    // 异常处理后再调用，区分错误传播合同与持久状态损坏。
    assert css.validate("a { color: blue; }")
    assert dns.isIpv4("127.0.0.1") == 1
    println("recovery passed")
    return 0
end
interpretation: CSS and DNS valid inputs succeed; invalid predicates raise IOError/ValueError rather than return false/zero; subsequent valid inputs succeed. Other runtime failures require separate diagnosis.
